title: Sunny Yoke Tee

notes: Worked top down in one piece with short sleeves.

text.S: Cast on 96 sts with the 3 mm needle and join in the round.
text.M: Cast on 104 sts with the 3 mm needle and join in the round.
text.L: Cast on 112 sts with the 3 mm needle and join in the round.

steps.label: Rib
steps.text: *K1 tbl, p1*; repeat from * to end.
Change to the 4 mm needle and place a beginning-of-round marker.

steps.label: Round 6
steps.text: *Yarn over, k2tog*; repeat from * to end.

text.M: K3, *M1, k6*; repeat from * to end.

steps.label: Round 6
steps.text: *Yarn over, k2tog*; repeat from * to end.

text.M: K4, *M1, k6*; repeat from * to end.

steps.label: Round 6
steps.text: *Yarn over, k2tog*; repeat from * to end.

steps.label: Divide for body and sleeves
steps.text: Divide the stitches for body and sleeves.

checklist.S: Put the first 27 sts on a holder (first sleeve)
checklist.M: Put the first 35 sts on a holder (first sleeve)
checklist.L: Put the first 35 sts on a holder (first sleeve)

checklist: Cast on 4 sts under the arm

checklist.S: Put the next 27 sts on a holder (second sleeve)
checklist.M: Put the next 35 sts on a holder (second sleeve)
checklist.L: Put the next 35 sts on a holder (second sleeve)

checklist: Cast on 4 sts under the arm

steps.text: Knit every round until the body measures 22 cm from the divide.
Work *k1 tbl, p1* rib until the rib measures 4 cm.

text.S: Put the 27 held sleeve sts on the 4 mm needle and pick up 4 sts under the arm.
text.M: Put the 35 held sleeve sts on the 4 mm needle and pick up 4 sts under the arm.
text.L: Put the 35 held sleeve sts on the 4 mm needle and pick up 4 sts under the arm.

steps.text: Work *k1 tbl, p1* rib until the rib measures 2 cm.

checklist: Sew the small gap under each arm

reviewNotes: Round 2 of pass 2 for size M starts with K3; double-check against the PDF.
